issue:
Key Pair ID Missing in EC2 Responses

It seems that the EC2 responses for key pairs are missing the `keyPairId` field. This field is crucial for identifying key pairs uniquely, and its absence is causing issues when trying to manage key pairs through the API.

To reproduce the issue, you can try creating a key pair and then describe it. The response should include the `keyPairId`, but currently, it does not. This is affecting operations that rely on this identifier for key pair management.

This issue is observed in the latest version and was not present in previous versions. Please look into this as it impacts the ability to manage key pairs effectively.

actions.old_string:
DESCRIBE_KEY_PAIRS_RESPONSE = """<DescribeKeyPairsResponse xmlns="http://ec2.amazonaws.com/doc/2013-10-15/">
    <requestId>59dbff89-35bd-4eac-99ed-be587EXAMPLE</requestId>
    <keySet>
    {% for keypair in keypairs %}
      <item>
           <createTime>{{ keypair.created_iso_8601 }}</createTime>
           <keyName>{{ keypair.name }}</keyName>
           <keyFingerprint>{{ keypair.fingerprint }}</keyFingerprint>
           {% if keypair.get_tags() %}
             <tagSet>
               {% for tag in keypair.get_tags() %}
                 <item>
                   <key>{{ tag.key }}</key>
                   <value>{{ tag.value }}</value>
                 </item>
               {% endfor %}
             </tagSet>
           {% endif %}
      </item>
    {% endfor %}
    </keySet>
 </DescribeKeyPairsResponse>"""
